traces: We need derangements of 8. Inclusion exclusion sum k0..8 (-1)^k binom8k(8-k)! = 8! sum (-1)^k/k!. Terms 40320-40320+20160-6720+1680-336+56-8+1 = 14833. Explain Ai fixes i intersection (8-k)!, count derangements. Provide clear formula and boxed result, enough steps not overdo.
answer:
A permutation in which no element appears in its original position is called a **derangement**.

By inclusion–exclusion, we begin with all \(8!\) permutations, subtract those fixing any chosen element, add back those fixing two chosen elements, and continue. Choosing \(k\) elements to fix leaves \((8-k)!\) ways to permute the rest, so the count is
\[
\begin{aligned}
D_8
&=\sum_{k=0}^{8}(-1)^k\binom{8}{k}(8-k)!\\
&=8!\left(1-1+\frac1{2!}-\frac1{3!}+\cdots+\frac1{8!}\right)\\
&=40320-40320+20160-6720+1680-336+56-8+1\\
&=\boxed{14833}.
\end{aligned}
\]
